in_sanskrit.name: Manvik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mind, intellect, wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manvik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Manvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘manas’ (mind) and ‘vij’ (wisdom or intellect). This name signifies a person who possesses a strong mind and vast intellect. It is also believed to be a name of Lord Vishnu.
